At Integrity Veterinary Center
Our medical team treats each pet as more than just a patient–they are unique individuals with their own personalities, needs, and stories. That’s why our medical team takes the time to get to know each pet beyond their diagnosis. Whether it’s a specialty appointment or an urgent care visit, we look at the whole pet, considering not only their medical conditions but also their behavior, lifestyle, and emotional well-being.
We approach every case with compassion, curiosity, and respect, working closely with our clients to create personalized care plans that truly support the health and happiness of their companions. Our goal is to provide thoughtful, comprehensive care that reflects the deep bond you share with your pet, because to us, they are your family.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Integrity Veterinary Center.
I was originally referred to them for treatment of my cat, who had been diagnosed with Inflamed Bowel Disease and Small Cell Lymphoma. When I called to establish care, the Front Desk Team was so incredibly kind, explained what their processes are, and scheduled us to see Dr. Weigand quickly!
Our first appointment, given the circumstances, was fantastic. Upon arrival they immediately took him into the back to begin vitals, etc. Soon after that, we were brought into a room that had a table, couch, and some chairs. I really appreciated this
... read more
set up - it felt like a cozy space to have a conversation about next steps in care instead of a sterile room. Dr. Weigand was FANTASTIC, she went over everything, from the diagnosis to the prognosis, to our treatment options. She explained everything in terms that we could understand, answered questions, and at no point did I feel rushed. She was very realistic in explaining what things would look like. We began treatment, and Integrity regularly followed up to check on our cat. It was easy to get in touch with them, easy to make follow up appointments, and I really appreciated that they offer 5/5:30 appointments.
We were in their care for some time, however unfortunately he took a turn for the worst. It was at that point that we utilized their Urgent Care. When I called, they immediately had us come, and upon arrival (2 different admissions), they immediately took him to the back, and we were in a consult room within 15 minutes. Everyone from the Front Desk to the Nursing Team, to the Veterinary Techs, and the two doctors we say were fantastic. They were compassionate, kind, reassuring, and I never felt that we were being judged for the decisions we made. When they had an update they'd call, and if I had questions, they quickly returned my calls. I also appreciated that while under the care of the Urgent Care, they were also regularly consulting Dr. Weigand. I ultimately had to make a decision that was in the best interest of my boy, and the care and kindness they showed us during that process was so appreciated. Thank you to ALL of the staff there who showed us kindness throughout our journey, but especially in the end. If I could transfer the care of my other cat here, I would.

I highly recommend Integrity Veterinary Center.  With much thanks especially to Dr. MaloneyHuss and Dr. Weigand and the nurses and vet techs, my cat was able to enjoy almost two and a half extra years (far exceeding the initial devastating diagnosis of two weeks to two months) and thrive well into her senior years.  The focus was always on quality of life and fine-tuning medical care to my cat’s complex needs.  Her final few years involved numerous medical issues and sometimes coordinating her care was threading a needle, but Integrity Veterinary Center always found a way.
... read more
I suspect that at some point, every single doctor, nurse, vet tech, and member of the reception team played a role in this exceptional and compassionate medical care.
The prices are transparent and reasonable (especially when you factor in the expertise and education of the doctors, nurses, vet techs, reception team, continuing education needs, not to mention the state-of-the-art equipment).  The doctors always thoroughly explained the reasons for what they did (and didn’t) recommend, and patiently addressed all questions.  Concerning time-sensitive questions, the team triaged and provided timely responses/advice, and were always extremely compassionate, even when delivering the most heartbreaking news.   Also, Integrity Veterinary Center’s communication with my cat’s general practitioner (local vet) was always seamless and easy, as was their communications with external surgeons.
When my cat (seventeen and a half years old at the time) needed dental surgery, I was told that a panel of doctors convened to weigh the risks and benefits (due to my cat’s age and multiple health issues), which were explained in detail, allowing me to make an informed decision on behalf of my senior cat’s best interests.  The cost was incredibly reasonable, especially factoring in the dentist and dedicated anesthesiologist and nurses and vet techs (thanks Dr. Brown and Dr. Mueller and the rest of the team) devoting comprehensive attention to my elderly higher-risk cat, and the extra post-surgery recovery attention.
Integrity Veterinary Center provides a wide array of medical services under one roof, and in many ways my cat’s medical care was more coordinated than most human medical care.  If my cat was there to see Dr. Weigand for internal medicine, and a question arose concerning another issue (cancer, dental issues, etc.), the doctors were able to communicate (sometimes quickly on the spot; sometimes after the appointment or within the next few days), and this is a tremendous value-added and also a hidden cost-savings, as it helps to efficiently identify and treat an issue (minimizing stress for my cat) so I could make a targeted follow-up appointment with the appropriate doctor (oncologist, specialist, dentist, local vet etc.).  This is one of the many benefits stemming from Integrity Veterinary Center’s independent ownership, allowing them to make unrestrained decisions aimed to provide the best care to patients, rather than being under the thumb of profit-mongering corporate or private-equity interests beholden to shareholders.
During my cat’s final days, it was a relief to be able to come to Integrity Veterinary Center’s urgent care, rather than trek to another facility lacking all of our extensive medical records and complex history.  It was also a huge solace that Dr. MaloneyHuss happened to be on call and was able to weigh in and share her expertise and recommendations through the urgent care doctors when it came time to make the hardest decisions.  Much thanks and appreciation to Dr. Melle and Dr. Stuart and nurses and vet techs and staff who were all so thorough, kind, and compassionate during some of the most heartbreaking days of my life.
When I adopt another cat, if the need arises I will go to Integrity Veterinary Center without hesitation, and I give the highest recommendation to this extraordinary practice.  I will be forever thankful and grateful for Integrity Veterinary Center’s role in helping my cat thrive an extra 28 months.  Thank you.
Mare of Cooktown
01/01/2026
Super fast, accommodating, expert veterinarians.

Plan Your Visit
We are excited to see you and your pet for your appointment! Here is some information to help make your appointment day go as smoothly as possible.
1
Directions and Parking:
IVC is located at
518 Pleasant St in Northampton, MA
. As you face the building, the hospital entrance is on the left side. Please feel free to park in one of the angled parking spots between IVC and the Shell station, or in the additional parking around the back of the Shell station.
2
Checking In:
Our waiting room is small and can quickly get busy. Therefore, we ask that you call us (
413-614-0039
) when you arrive to check in. One of our nurses will first take your pet’s medical history, and then ask you to come inside to one of our consultation rooms.
3
During Your Appointment:
Once the appointment begins, one of our nurses will weigh your pet, and measure/record their vital parameters. Once your pet’s doctor performs a physical examination, they will meet with you to discuss their findings and next steps in the appointment. Together, you will build a diagnostic and treatment plan for your pet. Please make sure you ask any questions that you have throughout this process. We are here to provide as much information as possible about your pet’s condition and medical care!
